transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I just can’t get past this feeling that I’ve failed… as a father, and just as a useful person. It keeps going around in my head, over and over, and I end up feeling like I don’t really deserve much of a future.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event?
Yes… it really started about a month ago, after my daughter left for college out of state. Since then it’s just kind of settled in and hasn’t let up.
If your daughter had not left for college, do you think you would still be feeling this way?
I don’t know for sure, but it really seems tied to her leaving. This has been going on for about a month now, ever since she went out of state for college.
Since your daughter left, has this been interfering with your day-to-day life?

Yes. It’s gotten in the way a lot. Bills are piling up, and things around the house I meant to handle just sit there because I can’t make myself follow through. I’ve also stopped going to book club or riding with the few people I used to see.

And… I don’t feel like I can just brush it off anymore. I’ve even started organizing my finances like someone else might need to deal with them, and that scares me.
Are you thinking about ending your life?

I’ve been having thoughts like… it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And it scared me when I realized I was going through my finances like I was getting things ready for someone else to handle.
Are you intending to kill yourself right now?

Right now… I don’t think I’m intending to do it this minute. But I have been thinking it might be easier if I didn’t wake up, and I scared myself when I caught myself going through my finances like I was getting things ready for someone else.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes. I used to really look forward to working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. Now the trains are just sitting there half-built on the table, and even turning a game on feels… pointless.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure how to answer that exactly. I’ve felt pretty low a lot, but I haven’t really been keeping track of whether it’s most of the day every day.
Since this started, have you been feeling down for most of the day nearly every day?
I still don’t know that I can say “most of the day nearly every day.” I’ve been feeling down a lot since it started, but I haven’t really been tracking it that closely.
Do you feel guilty or blame yourself in a way that seems excessive for your daughter leaving for college?

Yes… I do. It feels excessive, but I can’t shake it. I keep thinking I failed her somehow, and that I’ve failed as a father, and honestly as a useful person. It just loops in my head until I start feeling like I don’t deserve much of a future.
Since this started, have you been sleeping much more or much less than usual?

Much less than usual. I’ll lie in bed for hours because the house feels too quiet, and then if I do fall asleep I wake up around three or four in the morning. After that my mind starts going over everything I’ve messed up, and I can’t get back to sleep.
Since this started, have there been at least two weeks when you felt down or depressed nearly every day?
Yes. It’s been about a month now, since my daughter left for college out of state. I’d say there have definitely been at least two weeks where I felt down nearly every day.
Before your daughter left for college, have you ever had another period like this in your life?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had anything quite like this before, at least not that I can clearly remember. I’ve had hard times, but… I don’t know if they were the same as this.
Before this past month, have you ever had another period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day and lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that before where it was both feeling depressed nearly every day and not enjoying things. I’ve had rough periods, but I can’t say it was like this.
Since this started, has your appetite changed a lot?

Yes. I’m eating a lot less. Most days I don’t really bother making a proper meal, and sometimes I forget to eat until late. Then I’ll just have toast or cereal. I’ve noticed I’ve had to tighten my belt, so I guess I’ve lost some weight.
Since this started, have other people noticed that you’re moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?
I’m not sure. No one’s really said that to me directly. I feel slowed down inside, but I don’t know if I’m actually speaking or moving slower in a way other people notice.
Since this started, have you been feeling nervous or on edge a lot?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve felt unsettled at times, but I wouldn’t say I’ve clearly been nervous or on edge a lot. It’s hard for me to separate from just feeling bad overall.
Since this started, have you had a lot of trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Yes, a lot. I used to handle engineering spreadsheets without really thinking about it, but now I can sit there staring at something simple, like a grocery list or a bill, for half an hour and still not know what to do next. It’s frustrating.
In the two weeks before your daughter left for college, were you already feeling depressed nearly every day?
No, not really. It’s been about a month now, since my daughter left for college out of state. Before that, in the two weeks leading up to it, I don’t think it was nearly every day like it is now.
